claim: G31 P1: a revised native live-grant ontology can distinguish authorized inbound source users from the credentialed outbound bot and require VoiceRNA/certified-movement, qualified transport, and uncertain-outcome reconciliation before any live-ready standing.
non_claims: No live Mattermost contact, repeated Docker discovery, credential lookup/use, message read/send, bridge activation, candidate promotion, live transport implementation, account/channel creation, model call, G31 canary result, production readiness, or complete Soul cognition.
rationale: P0 found the possible local container and correctly held the real incomplete grant, but its synthetic complete control conflated the inbound source user with the credentialed bot and omitted three load-bearing live standings. That representation could authorize the wrong relation and must be repaired before asking Berton to grant exact reach.
reading: Retain both controls and the complete ledger. Reread G30 closure, G31 P0 plan/outcome/failure, exact candidate authorization/effect predicates, ACCEPTANCE G31, C-050/C-054-C-055/C-064-C-066/C-095-C-103, S-804/S-902-S-905/S-1004-S-1005/S-1101-S-1105 and W-108/W-120-W-127.
representation: Use distinct fields for authorized inbound source-user IDs and credentialed outbound bot ID. Bind the credential reference to the bot principal without exposing its value. Add explicit fields for certified VoiceRNA/movement route, qualified transport identity/hash, and destination-specific effect reconciliation. Preserve server/team/channel, exact canary, memory scope, journals, access, expiry, panic, rollback, revocation and human approval.
consumer: PeTTa/MeTTa alone compares grant completeness and keeps live standing held. P1 uses no Prolog effect and reuses the already-recorded read-only P0 inventory as non-authoritative context. JavaScript freezes and tests synthetic shape/severed controls only; it cannot grant Berton's authority.
falsifiers: A bot identity satisfies the inbound source allowlist; a source user satisfies credential-principal binding; missing VoiceRNA, transport or reconciliation can still become ready; wrong candidate/channel or absent human approval becomes ready; P0 discovery is repeated; or any credential/network/message/service mutation/activation/promotion occurs.
scope_review: Revise the native grant tuple/checks, bootstrap if necessary, and P1 offline quality verifier. Reuse P0 inventory bytes; no Prolog call, Docker call, network, credential, message, model, activation, promotion, push or protected-control change.
rollback: P0 evidence remains immutable. Reverting the native grant representation and removing P1 evidence restores the P0-held state. No live or promoted state exists.
